{
  "dataset_name": "volcanoes_c1",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of V1 and V2 coordinates, providing a diagonal linear projection.",
      "value_range": [32.0, 2016.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth linear combination of spatial coordinates, directly usable by linear SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 + V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between V1 and V2 coordinates, representing the orthogonal diagonal projection.",
      "value_range": [-1000.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative offset between the two spatial dimensions, useful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 - V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_euclidean_center",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the approximate center of the coordinate space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 800.0],
      "feature_family": "distance_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Introduces a non-linear radial feature that a linear SVM can use to separate central from peripheral instances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt((V1 - 510.0)**2 + (V2 - 510.0)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_manhattan_center",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Manhattan distance from the approximate center of the coordinate space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1100.0],
      "feature_family": "distance_metric",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an alternative L1 distance metric from the center, creating diamond-shaped decision boundaries when used by a linear model.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V1 - 510.0) + np.abs(V2 - 510.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed V3 intensity to compress the upper tail and smooth the distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the impact of extreme V3 values, creating a smoother continuous feature for the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_squared",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Squared V3 intensity to emphasize higher values and create a non-linear severity measure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to fit a quadratic response to the V3 intensity, increasing sensitivity to high-intensity regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V3 ** 2"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized V1 coordinate.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the scale of V1, ensuring it contributes equally to the SVM margin penalty.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 510.0) / 280.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v2_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized V2 coordinate.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the scale of V2, ensuring it contributes equally to the SVM margin penalty.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 510.0) / 288.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized V3 intensity.",
      "value_range": [-7.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the scale of V3, preventing it from being overshadowed by the larger coordinate values in the SVM optimization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 - 0.411) / 0.061"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_max_min_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the maximum to the minimum of V1 and V2, capturing coordinate imbalance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights instances that are far off the diagonal, providing a scale-invariant measure of spatial asymmetry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(V1, V2) / (np.minimum(V1, V2) + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v3_anomaly_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of V3's deviation from typical background levels, scored continuously.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a domain-informed continuous severity score that the linear SVM can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "spatial_edge_proximity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of how close the V1, V2 coordinates are to the boundary of the observable region.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures edge effects or boundary conditions that might systematically alter the expected intensity, useful as a linear adjustment factor.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
